(Japanese: '''レックウザ ライジング''' ''Rayquaza Rising'') is the fourth arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that aired on [[TV Tokyo]] from October 11, 2024, to March 21, 2025. Following their [[Tera Training]], [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] reunite with the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] aboard the restored [[Brave Olivine]] to complete their quest for the [[Six Heroes]]. Their {{pkmn|journey}} takes them from [[Kitakami]] to [[Area Zero]], where they uncover shocking revelations about [[Lucius]], [[Gibeon]], and Liko's own heritage. The arc serves as the climactic confrontation of the series' first major storyline, culminating in a decisive battle at [[Laqua]] that sets up future adventures. The arc's opening theme is [[Only One Story]] performed by {{wp|Zerobaseone|ZEROBASEONE}} and the ending theme [[Sparkle!]] is by Rina Matsuda & Hikaru Morita of {{wp|Sakurazaka46}}. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== After reuniting with the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], [[Friede]] returns [[Lucius]]'s Pokémon to Liko's care, leading to a battle with {{TP|Lucius|Arboliva}}, {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}}, and {{TP|Lucius|Lapras}}. The group travels to [[Kitakami]], where they meet [[Carmine]], [[Briar]], and [[Perrin]]. During their search for the remaining [[Six Heroes]], they discover [[Lucius's Kleavor]] and learn about Lucius's connection to a woman named [[Rystal]]. The Rising Volt Tacklers reunite with [[Diana]], who reveals that Rystal was {{an|Terapagos}}'s original Trainer and Liko's great-great-grandmother. After Rystal shares the history of the original [[Explorers]] and [[Laqua]], Liko formally catches Terapagos, adpoting its original nickname ''[[Pagogo]]''. The group then travels to [[Johto]] and eventually [[Area Zero]] in [[Paldea]], where they discover that [[Lucius's Entei]] is actually a {{TP|Lucius|Gouging Fire}}. At Area Zero, the group encounters the [[Black Rayquaza]], which Roy captures after an intense battle. The Black Rayquaza leads them to Laqua, where they face the [[Explorers]] in a climactic confrontation. There, they discover that Lucius has been sealed in [[Laquium]] crystals, and encounter [[Gibeon]] for the first time. After [[Amethio]] turns against Gibeon to help the protagonists, Liko's {{TP|Liko|Floragato}} evolves into {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}} during their battle. Pagogo transforms into its [[Stellar Form]] and purifies Laqua alongside the Six Heroes, but this causes Lucius and Gibeon to fade away. [[Spinel]] uses the remaining Laquium to make the Six Heroes go berserk, and Friede along with his {{TP|Friede|Charizard}} disappears while rescuing the group, setting up the next arc. ==Gallery==
